mechanism_narrative: A higher federal funds rate level is associated with lower S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to increased discount rates on equity valuations, with no threshold required for the signal to be active.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negatively correlated with FEDFUNDS level (Rank IC < 0.03) over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year CPI (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 300, it signals persistent inflation that triggers aggressive monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative when CPIAUCSL > 300 (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 in any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of a low unemployment rate (UNRATE < 4.0%) and strong monthly employment growth (PAYEMS increase > 100k) signals an overheating labor market that triggers aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when both UNRATE < 4.0 and PAYEMS growth > 100k (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 in any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime (HOUST > 1500 and RSAFS > 700,000), a decline in housing starts (HOUST) signals an economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when HOUST declines in the late-cycle regime (HOUST>1500 and RSAFS>700000) (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 in any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of industrial production (INDPRO) is associated with stronger economic activity, which supports corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly positively correlated with INDPRO level (Rank IC < 0.03) over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 5.0%, it signals an economic slowdown that triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when UNRATE > 5.0 (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 in any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals a broad-based economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when both HOUST and RSAFS decline (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 in any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 300), a higher federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) level is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to increased expectations of aggressive monetary policy.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative when FEDFUNDS is high in the high inflation regime (CPIAUCSL>300) (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 in any 2-year window.
